results.title: Dear Future Ejaculators
results.overview: Ledermann & Marschner create an opulent iconography of testicles: Whatever’s in the sac, they expose to the studio lights with with relish and no taboos. The viewer’s gaze glides over naked testicles, touches baroque jewellery and explores questions of relationships and responsibility.

results.title: 19th Floor
results.overview: For three years, the director has been capturing the ever-changing face of Bogotá from the windows of her 19th-floor flat. The time-lapse footage alternates between day and night, depicting everything from minor street scenes to major events – fireworks, a fire, demonstrations and riots. Their political context is occasionally complemented by the sound of television news reports. Gradually, however, the filmmaker’s private life also becomes interwoven with her observations of the city: we hear conversations with her partner and read their messages to one another, ranging from everyday questions about what’s for dinner to tense moments in their relationship.

results.title: The Heist
results.overview: When a teen's phone is confiscated by her parents, she must go to great lengths to retrieve it, learning a thing or two about the world outside of her screen along the way.

results.title: Las compañías
results.overview: A woman searches for Manuel Puig’s grave in the cemetery of La Plata (Buenos Aires). She finds it, although she is told it is not the right one. It does not matter that her arguments defy reason; she chooses to cling to belief. A walk through the cemetery transformed into ritual, a clepsydra-like time, and a map of the places where, many years ago, other bluish encounters took place, alongside Manuel’s new pink-hued territories. And a favorite song.

results.title: Run
results.overview: London has fallen. Food is scarce, hope is fading, and the undead roam the streets. When two survivors embark on a dangerous supply run, an encounter with the infected forces them apart. Alone in a city overrun by the dead, each must fight to survive and find their way back to the other.

results.title: Merry Christmas, Ms. Christmas

results.title: A Nadadora
results.overview: Costa da Morte, 1990s. Nico is a young girl who spends her days poaching alongside her father, Tano, a former heroin addict who shares his profits with her. But sometimes, a strange noise creeps into Nico’s mind. The world goes dark, and she loses consciousness, only to wake up somewhere else, with no memory of how she got there. As these absences become part of her life, Nico begins to venture into the unknown depths of her own mind, discovering something unexpected in the darkness: a strength that makes her feel less alone.

results.title: The Night of Halloween
results.overview: On Halloween night, Michael Myers escapes into a quiet neighborhood after fleeing Smith’s Grove Sanitarium. As the streets fall silent, Beatriz becomes the target of his relentless pursuit.

results.title: Shyrmauyq
results.overview: In a small village, old woman Ayimkhan, backbone of her family, lives with her son, Samat; his wife, Gulzhan; and their 8-year-old daughter, Umit. Ayimkhan supports the family through her pension, labor, and devoted care. However, Gulzhan, who has grown tired of rural life, wants to move to the city; one day she finally leaves home. The burden of housework and caring for her granddaughter falls on Ayimkhan's shoulders alone. Daily life flows quietly, apparently unchanged, yet within it, the family is falling apart.
